# fetchAsDataUrl

## Summary

Fetches an image URL and returns it as a data URL sized for vision-model input. It reads the bytes directly, falling back to the Boxel proxy (`SendRequestViaProxyCommand`) when a cross-origin CDN blocks the browser read, then downscales anything whose long edge exceeds `maxEdge` (default 1568 — the edge vision providers resize to anyway) and re-encodes to WebP, which keeps alpha. Images already small enough are returned untouched, a degraded encode is discarded in favour of the original, and decode failures never block a generation.

## Import

```ts
import { fetchAsDataUrl } from '../util/realm-image';
```

## Usage

The studio (`components/studio-isolated.gts`) and `AnalyzeReferenceCommand` call it on every reference image before a vision request, passing stage-specific `maxEdge` values (`ANALYZE_MAX_EDGE`, `BUILD_SECONDARY_EDGE`) and the command context for the proxy fallback.
